Latent heat

quiz.q: How does most groundwater move through soil and rock?

wrongFeedback.Open underground rivers: Most groundwater moves through pores and cracks, rather than open rivers.

myth.s: Groundwater flows in big underground rivers and lakes.
myth.why: Almost all groundwater seeps through tiny pores in soil and rock, like water held in a sponge.
myth.tryIt: In Journey Mode, take the Infiltration path: the aquifer leg is the slowest part of the cycle.
